title: Handling Missing Data in Probabilistic Regression Trees
abstract: arXiv:2608.06195v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Probabilistic regression trees are a smooth alternative to classical regression trees, consistent in the complete-data case, producing continuous predictions through probabilistic split assignments. This paper extends this framework by proposing three approaches to accommodate missing predictor values directly during tree construction, without a separate imputation step. These modifications are defined to preserve the fundamental probabilistic properties of the original methodology, including probability conservation and marginal compatibility, under arbitrary patterns of missing covariate values. The proposed methods are evaluated on several real-world datasets exhibiting different levels of missingness and are compared with classical regression trees. In addition, a semi-synthetic study, in which missing values are injected completely at random, at random and not at random, compares the proposed strategies with impute-then-fi

translated_title: 概率回归树中缺失数据的处理
translated_abstract: 概率回归树是经典回归树的一种平滑替代方案，在完整数据情况下具有一致性，通过概率化的分裂分配产生连续的预测。本文扩展了这一框架，提出了三种方法，可以在树构建过程中直接处理缺失的预测变量值，而无需单独的插补步骤。这些修改被定义为在任意缺失协变量值模式下，保留原始方法的基本概率特性，包括概率守恒和边缘兼容性。所提出的方法在几个呈现不同程度缺失的真实数据集上进行了评估，并与经典回归树进行了比较。此外，一项半合成研究（其中缺失值以完全随机、随机和非随机方式注入）将所提出的策略与先插补后拟合的方法进行了比较。
tldr: 本文提出三种在概率回归树构建过程中直接处理缺失预测变量值的方法，无需单独的插补步骤，并能在任意缺失模式下保持概率守恒和边缘兼容性等基本概率特性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes three methods to handle missing predictor values directly during probabilistic regression tree construction without a separate imputation step, while preserving fundamental probabilistic properties such as probability conservation and marginal compatibility under arbitrary missingness patterns.
